title: Bayesian fast-and-frugal trees: code and results for "The price or bonus of transparency"
description: The harness, the build and analysis scripts, and the results files that reproduce every number in the paper The price or bonus of transparency: Bayesian fast-and-frugal trees, by Alex Bogdan and Konstantinos V. Katsikopoulos. The raw datasets are not included: fetch_data.py downloads each file from its public source and checks it against the SHA-256 recorded when it was first retrieved. See the README for what each folder holds and how to rerun the analyses.
